lines.text: CoreWeave Q3: $3.66B revenue and a $709M net loss; raises FY revenue guide to $13.0 to $13.3B
Google makes Gemini 4 Carbon available on the paid Gemini API at $2/$10 through 30 Nov
Baidu releases ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview (280B/14B active); Apache 2.0 weights due by 25 Nov

feed.headline: CoreWeave Q3 revenue is $3.66B with a $709M net loss; FY revenue guide rises to $13.0-$13.3B
feed.why: Official print: $3.661B revenue vs $1.365B a year earlier, adjusted operating income $379M, backlog about $132.5B. Interest expense was $846M.

feed.headline: Google makes Gemini 4 Carbon available on the paid Gemini API at $2/$10 through 30 Nov
feed.why: API id gemini-4-carbon, 1,048,576-token context. Price steps to $4/$20 on 1 Dec. Not on the free tier. AA High remains 60, behind Fable 5.2 at 65.

feed.headline: Baidu releases ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview, a 280B MoE with 14B active, on Qianfan
feed.why: 1M context. English post: Apache 2.0 weights coming soon. Chinese post: weights open by 25 Nov. Preview checkpoint; no AA or Epoch score yet.

feed.headline: Anthropic's IPO site says it expects to price on 18 Nov and trade on 19 Nov
feed.why: Per its FAQ, subject to regulatory clearance. Range remains $70 to $78 a share, listing on Nasdaq as ANT.

feed.headline: New York opens a RAISE Act portal for large frontier AI developers
feed.why: Register by 1 Jan 2027. From January: safety frameworks, 72-hour incident reports, and model transparency reports. A new state AI safety center also launched.

feed.headline: AA launches MKA; Fable 5.2 leads at 57%, Gemini 4 Carbon is #2 at 54%
feed.why: 200 visual knowledge-work tasks built with DeepMind. Carbon costs $6.29 per task vs $31.97 for Fable 5.2, per AA.

feed.headline: OpenAI starts Businesses in ChatGPT in beta, including Business Agents
feed.why: Firms can claim a profile and add product feeds. Business Agents start with eligible US ecommerce and online-service businesses.

feed.headline: Anthropic adds Claude Sheets, Whiteboards, and generally available Claude Data
feed.why: Anthropic says these start today. Its own page still calls Claude Meetings coming soon, narrower than some press reports of a beta.

feed.headline: NVIDIA donates OpenShell to CNCF and previews Kubernetes Engine and Snapshot
feed.why: Announced at KubeCon. Snapshot design partners report much faster GPU workload restores; those times are partner figures.
